## 1. The playable game (`main.py` + `game/`)

### Mechanics

| Feature | Details |

| Movement | Acceleration / friction with separate air control + max speed |
28

| Jump | Variable jump height (release early to cut the jump), **coyote time**, **jump buffering**, fast-fall (hold DOWN) |
29
+
| Combat | Stomp enemies Mario-style; side contact costs a life + 1.2s invulnerability blink |
30

| Enemies | **Walkers** (patrol ledges), **Flyers** (sine-wave flight over pits), **Jumpers** (charge up, hop toward you) |
31

32
+
| Checkpoint | A mid-level flag — touch it and respawns continue from there |
33
+
| Pits | Three 2-tile pits; falling costs a life (respawn at checkpoint) |
34
+
| Goal | Reach the golden waving flag at the far right |

+

### Design & polish

+

+
- Parallax background: sky gradient, sun, drifting clouds, two hill layers
